3
Assistance to and Protection of Victims
of Crime and Witnesses
to  receive  prompt,  adequate  and  fair  redress
including  reparation  and  restitution  which  is
commensurate  with  any  injury,  damage  or  loss
suffered as a victim of crime;
to be protected from any injury or potential injury,
including  threats,  intimidation,  reprisal  or
retaliation;
to  be  treated  for  any  physical,  psychological,
emotional  or  mental  harm,  including  impairment
or disability, suffered as a victim of crime;
where such victim of crime is a child, to be treated
in a manner that ensures the best interest of such
child;
where   such victim of crime is a female who has to
be medically examined, to make a request to be so
examined, by a female medical professional; and
where the offence is of sexual nature, to specify the
gender  of  the  officer  who  is  to  carry  out  the
investigation or inquiry into the offence.
